note: Erinnerungen (TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE §12.10): abgeschlossene Szenen noch einmal besuchen und in die Gegenwart zurückkehren. Sachlich, ohne Belohnungssprache. Rückblick-Zeilen in der Stimme der Figur (Alexei knapp und müde, Konrad genau), erste Person, Vergangenheit; sie erfinden nichts, was im Spiel nicht geschehen ist. Monatsangaben statt erfundener Tage.

strings.ui.memories.place.L_M1_Plaza: Square before the Great Hall, Berlin
strings.ui.memories.echo.inspect: I remember this paper. Every line of it.
strings.ui.memories.echo.puzzle: This is where the puzzle lay. I still remember how long it took me.
strings.ui.memories.echo.a1_solve_signal: Square, circle, triangle – as on the seal and in the timetable. The old practice box answered. The only one that did, that day.
strings.ui.memories.echo.m1_align_plans: Here the two plans lay one on top of the other. Only when the lines matched did I see the second wall – and the corridor behind it.
strings.ui.memories.echo.c3b_solve_protocol: Chair, Reich delegation, secretariat, Soviet side. Only in that order could I read what Elena had written in the margin.
strings.ui.memories.decided_none: This is where I had to decide.
strings.ui.memories.decided.share_with_irina: Here I showed Irina the whole discrepancy.
strings.ui.memories.decided.keep_private: Here I kept the clue to myself.
strings.ui.memories.decided.preserve_evidence: Here I decided to secure my own copy of the note.
strings.ui.memories.decided.request_explanation: Here I decided to demand an official statement.
strings.ui.memories.decided.ask_elena: Here I asked Elena to compare Annex C with me after the session.
strings.ui.memories.decided.note_alone: Here I noted the seal number and kept searching alone.
strings.ui.memories.decided.share_protocol: Here I showed him Elena’s note on paragraph four.
strings.ui.memories.decided.search_elena: Here we talked only about Elena – where she had last been seen.
strings.ui.memories.decided.report_delegation: Here I decided to report the incident to my delegation.
